subcategory_text: Configure toolchains to produce consistent, reproducible artefacts and to make the security status of the software visible throughout the development lifecycle.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SA-15, CM-3, CM-5
implementation_examples: Emit SBOM and provenance attestations for every build
Expose security-test results in a developer-facing dashboard
Reproduce builds from source with declared dependencies
assessment_objectives: Determine whether the toolchain produces reproducible artefacts.
Determine whether security status is visible to developers throughout the lifecycle.
